originalValidatorDefect.effect: Shell-quoted Graphify commands were falsely reported as missing.
originalValidatorDefect.rawTraceResult: All 18 Graphify-arm runs invoked the public Graphify CLI.
originalValidatorDefect.disposition: The future-facing validator now reuses the audited shell-command parser. The retained raw evidence and original summary were not rewritten or rerun.

independentScoringFromRetainedRawRuns.method: Exact typed claims, required files, and recorded run errors using the committed scoreRun contract; the invocation false positives do not count as run errors.

genuineFailures.graphifyCommonCause: Each run invoked graphify query --help; the approved gateway rejects all public subcommand flags with exit code 2.

failures: Graphify correctness is below source-only correctness.
passedConditions: Median tool-output bytes improved by 25.5%, above the required 20%.
Median files opened regressed by 3.8%, within the allowed 10%.

requiredNextDecision: A safe public subcommand-help contract and a new versioned evaluation protocol would change the approved boundary and require a rebuilt candidate plus a fresh non-replacement evaluation matrix.
